plain: In 2013 a heat-sensing camera filmed an unexplained object near the airport at Aguadilla, Puerto Rico. Some describe the object as plunging into the ocean and coming back out. The UFO skeptic Mick West discusses the video in a 2025 debate episode, placing it over the airport at what he calls a "big tourist destination". Michels tells it in a 2026 episode with a Navy admiral. He describes "this, you know, 3 minute video of a trans medium object", meaning one that can move between air and water. According to Michels, it "seems to descend into the Atlantic Ocean and then come out as well." If that reading is right, it would point to a craft able to pass through water and air in ways ordinary aircraft cannot. The two men frame it very differently. West treats it as a video to be explained, while Michels gives no ordinary explanation for it.
